words_of_the_day.example: Through hard work and perseverance, he achieved all his life goals.
Diligent students always achieve high results in their exams.
She gave an eloquent speech that moved the entire audience.
The community showed great resilience in rebuilding after the storm.

words_of_the_day.translation: Har bir mayda-chuydaga e'tibor beruvchi, sinchkov
words_of_the_day.example: He was meticulous about keeping his records up to date.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: She wants to buy ___ new car because her old one broke down.
questions.explanation: 'New' so'zi undosh tovush bilan boshlangani uchun va noaniq yakka ot ifodalanganligi sababli 'a' artikli qo'yiladi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: ___ Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean on Earth.
questions.explanation: Okeanlar, dengizlar va daryolar nomlari oldidan har doim 'The' aniq artikli ishlatiladi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Our flight departs ___ Monday morning at 8:30 AM.
questions.explanation: Hafta kunlari va aniq kunlarning vaqt oralig'i (Monday morning) oldidan 'on' predlogi ishlatiladi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: She is capable ___ handling complex software architectures.
questions.explanation: 'Capable' sifati o'zidan keyin 'of' predlogi va Gerund (-ing) shaklini talab qiladi (capable of doing sth).

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Water ___ at 100 degrees Celsius under standard atmospheric pressure.
questions.explanation: Tabiat qonunlari va ilmiy faktlar har doim Present Simple zamonida ifodalanadi (he/she/it uchun fe'lga -s qo'shiladi).

questions.subject: english
questions.question: By the time we arrived at the cinema, the movie ___ already.
questions.explanation: O'tgan zamondagi boshqa bir harakatdan oldin sodir bo'lib tugallangan harakat uchun Past Perfect (had + V3) ishlatiladi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: By next December, we ___ on this research project for three years.
questions.explanation: Kelajakdagi ma'lum vaqtgacha davom etib kelgan va davom etayotgan harakat uchun Future Perfect Continuous ishlatiladi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: You ___ wear a helmet while riding a motorcycle; it is mandatory by law.
questions.explanation: Qonuniy qat'iy majburiyat va zaruratni ifodalash uchun 'must' modallik fe'li ishlatiladi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: He has not slept for 24 hours. He ___ be completely exhausted.
questions.explanation: Kuchli mantiqiy xulosa va ishonchni ifodalashda 'must be' (shubhasiz shunday bo'lsa kerak) ishlatiladi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: You ___ him the secret. Now everyone in the office knows about it!
questions.explanation: O'tgan zamonda qilingan noto'g'ri ishdan afsuslanish yoki tanqid qilish uchun 'shouldn't have + V3' ishlatiladi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: If I ___ more free time, I would learn how to play the piano.
questions.explanation: Second Conditional (hozirgi zamondagi noreal orzu-istaklar): If + Past Simple, would + V1 tuzilmasi talab qilinadi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: If you had informed me earlier, I ___ the conference schedule.
questions.explanation: Third Conditional (o'tgan zamondagi noreal vaziyat): If + Past Perfect, would have + V3.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Choose the synonym of 'Accurate':
questions.explanation: 'Accurate' so'zi 'aniq', 'to'g'ri' degan ma'noni bildiradi. Uning eng yaqin sinonimi 'Precise' dir.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Choose the antonym of 'Abundant':
questions.explanation: 'Abundant' (mo'l-ko'l, yetarli) so'zining antonimi 'Scarce' (taqchil, kamyob) hisoblanadi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What does the idiom 'Bite the bullet' mean?
options: To face a difficult situation with courage
questions.explanation: 'Bite the bullet' iborasi muqarrar bo'lgan qiyin yoki noxush vaziyatni mardlik bilan qabul qilishni anglatadi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The new bridge ___ next month by the president.
questions.explanation: Kelasi zamon ('next month') majhul nisbat shakli 'will be + V3' (will be opened) bo'ladi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'I am learning Python,' said Aziz. -> Aziz said that he ___ Python.
questions.explanation: O'zlashtirma gapda (Reported speech) bosh gap o'tgan zamonda bo'lsa, Present Continuous -> Past Continuous ga o'zgaradi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Read: 'Renewable energy sources such as solar and wind do not emit greenhouse gases.' What is the main point?
questions.explanation: Matn qayta tiklanuvchi energiya manbalari issiqxona gazlarini chiqarmasligi, ya'ni ekologik toza ekanligini ta'kidlaydi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Hardly ___ the station when the train pulled away.
questions.explanation: 'Hardly', 'Scarcely', 'No sooner' kabi inkor yuklamalari gap boshida kelganda inversiya (had + ega + V3) yuz beradi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: I look forward to ___ from you soon.
questions.explanation: 'Look forward to' birikmasidagi 'to' predlog hisoblanadi va undan keyin Gerund (V-ing) qo'llaniladi.
